# Preface {.unnumbered}

This logbook records the progress of the *Ability or Environment? Peer
Congestion in the Making of Academic Human Capital* project (see
`../paper/paper.qmd`), in the same spirit as the `logbook/` convention used in
`doctor-tasks`: one dated entry per work session, describing what was done,
what was found, and what changed.

**Adding a new entry:**

1. Create `entries/YYYYMMDD.qmd` (use a letter suffix — `20260901b.qmd` —
   for a second entry the same day).
2. Add it to the `chapters:` list in `_quarto.yml`, in chronological order.
3. Render with `quarto render logbook/` (from the project root) to rebuild
   `logbook/_book/`.
